# Pinned alias and re-export control

Owned source and an actual scip-typescript 0.6.0 index exercise an overloaded
export, imported aliases, a renamed re-export and an unrelated same-named helper.
The companion receipt binds the original index bytes to the five source/config
files. Its tool hashes identify the provisioned producer used for generation.

Independent TypeScript 6.0.3 source-symbol traversal finds eight references to the
exported `alpha` symbol. This index assigns seven to that native identity. The
`outward` import name in `c.ts` is recorded as undefined `local 2`, while the
aliased consumer binding and call refer to `alpha`.

This fixture tests faithful uncertainty preservation. It requires DeepThought to
retain the unresolved import and partial graph status. It does not certify
complete semantic reference coverage. The failed compiler comparison is retained
in the SCIP refinement results. This small correctness control is excluded from
agent performance measurements, which use the pinned GraphQL.js production tree.
